newsitem.title: USA: US natgas stocks seen up 72-82 bcf in weekly AGAs.
newsitem.headline: US natgas stocks seen up 72-82 bcf in weekly AGAs.

text.p: U.S. natural gas storage levels were expected to rise by 72 to 82 billion cubic feet (bcf) when weekly American Gas Association (AGA) data are released later today, industry sources said Wednesday.

The Reuter poll of industry players showed expectations for an overall build ranged from 63 bcf to 90 bcf for the week ended September 27, with most estimates in the middle of the range. The four-week average is 91 bcf.
